result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. I've rewritten round 7 to fit the bounded workflow: it now covers C's three round-6 bugs and no new feature.

**What C proved in round 6:** RF6-2 and R10-N5 failed; every other round-6 ID passed. tsc, the tests (761/761), build and biome all pass. The 4 protected purchase files are unchanged, `/studio-lab` opens anonymously, and the anonymous token request returns 401. The C-evidenced backlog changes (C-R5-01..05, B-R5-01 and root-M3 closed; C-R6-01..03 opened; SRW-03 and SRW-10 marked as having open bugs) were already in the backlog from the earlier session; I checked them against C's report and didn't redo them.

**Round 7 (`current-task.md`):**
- **S1, C-R6-02 (Medium), drift got worse after round 6.** A measures before changing anything. Two direct checks:
  - **RF7-P1:** per-frame playback code doesn't force a layout recalculation (Γëñ 1 ms per frame).
  - **RF7-P2:** clips, overview bars, library rows and ruler ticks don't re-render on Play/Pause, and the Play click costs Γëñ 16 ms (median).

  Then the drift and first-Play runs, capped at 3 valid runs plus at most 2 replacements per layout. Tolerances are unchanged. The two direct checks share the drift runs and don't add to the cap. A's attempt to reproduce the first-Play failure keeps C's exact order (5 loop runs first).
- **S2, C-R6-03 (Low):** after Fit, the last ruler label must not stick out past the timeline (Γëñ 1 px), and no label may be cut in half.
- **S3, C-R6-01 (Low):** dragging a Volume slider becomes a normal edit gesture (rule D-30), so a second pointer can't edit mid-drag.
- Docs 015 and 016 make no PASS claims. C checks only these items plus the behaviours they could break.
- Same rules as before: exact file list, the purchase/auth files protected, `Header.tsx` frozen, round-6 work not reverted, no commits.

**Scheduling choices:**
- **SRW-11B moves to rounds 8ΓÇô10, in three stages:** detail panel, then track fold/height/auto-fit, then the floating video. Its full acceptance is kept. The policy forbids mixing a feature with a sync investigation, so this is reordering, not a cut.
- **The 21 regression IDs C didn't re-run in round 6 are recorded as debt, not PASS.** They are due at the full regression after SRW-11B.
- **If drift still fails within the run cap:** if RF7-P1/P2 pass, the next step is your real-Chrome check and round 8 goes ahead; C-R6-02 stays open with no PASS. If RF7-P1/P2 also fail, round 8 starts with drift again.
- **The "three related bugs" grouping is a judgement call.** The bugs come from the same round-6 timeline work and touch the same files, but the link is loose. The reasoning is recorded in `b-round-6.md`.

**Files written (planning only, no app code):**
- `current-task.md` (the earlier draft is kept as `tasks/round-7-before-bounded-policy.md`; `tasks/round-6.md` untouched)
- `feature-status.md` (first version of the progress board)
- `backlog.json` (v8)
- `b-round-6.md`, `b-next.json`, `b-round-6-checkpoint.md`
- `plan.md`: only the round and status lines

Backups of the old backlog and plan are in `%TEMP%`.

**Still waiting on you:**
- the drift check on a quiet real Windows Chrome (VP9 + H.264), now required evidence;
- the real-mouse checks: scrollbars, library drag, cross-lane drag with Shift, ruler drag, Ctrl+wheel and pinch;
- the wheel behaviour on the purchased `/studio/*` page, which I can't check because that route is protected;
- permission for the purchased-library page mount (part of SRW-21). It isn't blocking yet because other work remains.

The advisor was available and I called it twice, before and after writing; both rounds of advice are applied.
